description: This file defines the YAHOO.widget.Menu class as part of the YUI library, providing functionality for creating, managing, and interacting with menus in web applications. It includes the class constructor, properties, event handling, internal methods for item and subgroup management, and configuration options. The file also manages global menu instances via MenuManager and handles DOM interactions, event subscriptions, and submenu configuration.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: A class extending YAHOO.widget.Overlay that creates a flexible menu container with support for grouping, submenu configuration, event handling, and dynamic display options.

classes.name: MenuBar
classes.description: Represents a horizontal menu bar with item grouping, submenus, and configurable positioning and toggle behaviors.

classes.name: MenuBarItem
classes.description: Defines a menu item within a MenuBar, supports submenus, styling, focus, and interaction handling.

classes.name: ContextMenu
classes.description: Creates a context menu that appears on right-click or custom trigger, managing positioning, event handling, DOM references, and cancellation.

classes.name: MenuItem
classes.description: Represents individual menu items, including properties for text, URL, disabled/enabled state, submenu association, selection state, and event handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Menu instance with the provided element or HTML source, sets up event subscriptions, and registers the menu with the MenuManager.

methods.name: _initSubTree
methods.description: Traverses the DOM subtree of the menu source element to instantiate menu items and groups based on the markup.

methods.name: _getFirstEnabledItem
methods.description: Returns the first menu item that is enabled and visible.

methods.name: _addItemToGroup
methods.description: Adds a menu item to a specified group, creating the group if necessary, and updates DOM structure.

methods.name: _removeItemFromGroupByIndex
methods.description: Removes a menu item from a group based on its index, updating the DOM accordingly.

methods.name: _removeItemFromGroupByValue
methods.description: Removes a specific menu item from a group based on the item reference.

methods.name: _updateItemProperties
methods.description: Updates the index, group index, and class names for items within a group.

methods.name: _getItemGroup

methods.name: _subscribeToItemEvents

methods.description: Handles changes to the visibility of the menu, updating CSS classes.

methods.description: Cancels any scheduled show delay.

methods.name: _execSubmenuHideDelay

methods.name: _enableScrollHeader
methods.description: Enables the header used for scrolling the body of the menu.

methods.name: _enableScrollFooter

methods.description: Handles the mouseover event for the menu, managing active items and submenus.

methods.name: _onMouseOut

methods.name: _onMouseMove

methods.name: _onBeforeShow
